description: Renames a company template, or shares it with the organization or stops sharing it, as the app's Templates drawer does. Its creator can rename it and stop sharing it, only an admin can share their own template with the organization, and admins can also rename any shared one. Reports already built in it keep their look. Answers the template as listTemplates lists it.

name.description: The template's new name, as members see it in Rollstack.

sharedWithOrganization.description: Whether everyone in the organization can use the template, or only you. Only admins can share a template with the organization; a template's creator can stop sharing it.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

templateId.description: The company template to act on, by its `id` from `listTemplates`. Rollstack's own template can't be changed.

name: updateTemplate
title: Update template
